availability.source: Yahoo Finance member-site native quarterly CSV
availability.assumed_date_rule: For missing dates only, fiscal period end plus lag days; not a verified publication date
availability.quality_definition: latest available quarterly gross profit / latest available total assets
availability.value_definition: latest available common stock equity / historical market capitalization
availability.vintage: latest vendor versions; date references are not proof of original historical values

source_metadata.financial_versions: Latest Yahoo versions, potentially restated; not a point-in-time archive
source_metadata.shares: Historical Yahoo shares timestamps, last duplicate kept; publication times not independently verified
source_metadata.price_basis: Yahoo Close, no Adj Close or dividends; share counts matched to split-adjusted quote units
source_metadata.filters: US domicile, USD prices and financials; finite selected factors; quality/ROA require positive total assets; book-equity policy applies to selected value only; no size/liquidity filters

factor_definitions.value: Latest available common stock equity / positive historical market cap; signed B/M retained unless require_positive_book_equity=True
factor_definitions.quality: Latest available quarterly gross profit / latest available total assets
factor_definitions.earnings_yield: Sum of 4 consecutive available quarters of NetIncomeCommonStockholders / historical market cap; negative earnings retain their negative sign
factor_definitions.cashflow_yield: Sum of 4 consecutive available quarters of OperatingCashFlow / historical market cap; negative cash flow retains its sign
factor_definitions.roa: Sum of 4 consecutive available quarters of NetIncome / latest available total assets (ending-assets proxy, not average assets)
factor_definitions.low_volatility: Negative annualized sample standard deviation of the last 126 daily Close returns

source_metadata.partial_month: Omitted; only completed calendar months are ranked
